game_concept: A survival strategy set in Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza, a giant sundial plaza: the desert nomad must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza: a giant sundial plaza
core_gameplay_loop: In Sundial Plaza, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Each round, sandstorms strike the bazaar gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the bazaar gate from sandstorms in Sundial Plaza: keep the clean_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: clean_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Refactor Rescue' (Week 9 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sundial Plaza'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Sundial Plaza.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while clean_score > 0.
